3: > Build a multi-agent AI system that queries structured and semantic e-commerce data -- live, in 4 nights.

5: ## What is ShopAgent?
6: 
7: ShopAgent is an autonomous agent crew built on real e-commerce data. It answers business questions
8: by routing to the right data store: SQL for exact numbers, vectors for customer sentiment.
9: Days 1-3 run 100% locally with Docker. Day 4 migrates the same architecture to the cloud.
